statement.p: In geology, the density of granite is known to follow a normal distribution with a mean of 2.8 g/cm³ and a standard deviation of 0.075 g/cm³.

li.p: Using the Empirical Rule Calculator, determine the percentage of granite samples that have a density between 2.65 g/cm³ and 2.95 g/cm³.
Using the Empirical Rule Calculator, determine the percentage of granite samples that have a density less than 2.875 g/cm³
